title: Start here
lede: You are a new co-course director. Here is what you own, what OME handles, and what to do this week.

blocks.text: ExamSoft is where JABSOM writes exam questions, puts them into an assessment, delivers that assessment on student iPads, and reports on how the class did. You will spend most of your time in two places: the **question bank** and the **assessment** you build from it. Writing a question does not put it on an exam. Those are separate steps.

blocks.caption: Who does what
rows: Preview the assessment on a real iPad
Build the assessment (usually from last year's)
Proof it, send corrections back to you
Print two hard copies as a backup
Build the proctor PowerPoint, post the exam

blocks.title: Your draft is due 7 business days before the exam
blocks.text: Every other date is scheduled backwards from that one. If you remember one thing from this page, make it this.
Do these three things this week

items.d: Go to [the Legacy portal](https://ei.examsoft.com/GKWeb/login/hawaiimed). The institution ID is `hawaiimed`. It uses your UH login, so there is no separate ExamSoft password. If it will not let you in, see [Account and sign-in](docs/#account).
Open My Preferences, go to the Question Creation tab, set both font fields to Arial 12, then Save. Do this before you write anything. The screenshot below shows what the page looks like.

items.t: Open last year's exam for your course
items.d: You will almost certainly build from it rather than starting fresh. See [Building an assessment](docs/#building).

blocks.alt: The My Preferences page in the ExamSoft Legacy portal, Question Creation tab selected. Two font fields, Default Question Font and Default Answer Font, are both set to Arial 12. A name in the upper-right corner has been pixelated for privacy.
blocks.caption: My Preferences, Question Creation tab. Both font fields set to Arial 12. Do this before writing your first question.
blocks.flag: A former staff member's name is pixelated in the upper-right corner. The screenshot is otherwise unmodified.

items.detail: Questions written, ordered, categorized, attached. This is the handoff.
Staff preview on an iPad, send corrections back to you, re-preview, print backups, build proctor materials.
The download window opens so students can pull the exam onto their iPads.
Nobody can open the exam until then, even with the file downloaded.
The assessment overview shows how the class did.

blocks.title: Three things that surprise new course directors
blocks.text: Every question needs at least one category tag, or it disappears from reporting. Drag and Drop does not score the order answers are dragged in. And once the exam is posted and one student has downloaded it, the questions lock.
What the exam looks like on a student iPad
Students take the exam in Examplify, which locks the iPad for the duration. Below is a Hot Spot question in preview mode. The student drops a pin on the image to answer.

blocks.alt: Photograph of an iPad in Examplify preview mode showing a Hot Spot question. A blue teardrop pin has been dropped on a greyscale MRI image. Controls for zoom and reset run down the left side.
blocks.caption: A Hot Spot question in Examplify on an OME iPad. The blue pin is the student's answer.
